change.created: The change request is ready. Accept the notice again and submit the new evidence.
change.lead: Select only the categories that will change here. New identity details are entered later. The current verified profile stays effective until the new review passes.
change.title: Update the verified business profile

draft.description: Uploaded evidence status is restored from the server. Sensitive legal and identity values are never stored in the browser and must be entered again after leaving this page.
draft.title: Draft restored from the server

enterpriseOnly: This account is not a business customer and cannot use business verification.

evidence.invalid: Choose a PDF, JPG, or PNG file no larger than 5 MiB.
evidence.lead: The business license and legal representative identity evidence are required. An authorized agent also requires agent identity evidence and an authorization letter. Up to eight files are accepted.
evidence.title: Upload verification evidence

failed: Business verification is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.

form.invalid: Complete the valid business details and upload all evidence required for the selected applicant role.
form.lead: These values go only to this installation's local compliance service and are encrypted. They are never written to browser storage.
form.registrationHint: The first release accepts an 18-character mainland China unified social credit code
form.submitHint: Submission starts a local manual review. Only the server state decides the result; browser parameters cannot forge approval.
form.submitted: Business verification submitted for manual review
form.title: Enter business details

lead: Verify business details and evidence. Initial verification, corrected resubmission, and post-verification changes are handled here.

notice.accept: I have read and accept this business verification information notice
notice.begin: Accept and create a verification draft
notice.data: Data: legal business name, registration identifier, legal representative and agent identity details, and evidence files you choose to upload.
notice.purpose: Purpose: confirm the contracting, payment, invoicing, and service-use entity and meet this installation's local compliance requirements.
notice.recipient: Scope: data stays in this installation's local compliance service and is available only to authorized reviewers. It is not sent to the software provider.
notice.retention: Storage: evidence is encrypted in private server storage. The page and browser storage keep no raw identity values, filenames, or file contents.
notice.rights: Your choices: stop before submission, or correct and resubmit after rejection. During a post-verification change, the current verified profile stays effective.
notice.title: Business verification information notice

reason.identifier_invalid: The registration identifier is invalid. Check it and submit again.
reason.materials_incomplete: Evidence is incomplete. Add the missing evidence and submit again.
reason.materials_unreadable: Evidence is not readable. Replace it with a clear file and submit again.
reason.other: This review did not pass. Correct the information according to the review result and submit again.

rejected.title: This verification was returned and can be corrected and resubmitted

review.changeDescription: The new profile is under review. The current verified profile stays effective and is replaced only after approval.
review.description: Evidence has been submitted. This page will show the new server state after a local reviewer processes it.
review.title: Business verification is under manual review

security.description: The browser stores only random retry keys. Raw identity values, filenames, file contents, material numbers, and storage locations are never written to browser storage.
security.title: Sensitive business data stays in the local encrypted compliance service

status.hint: This is the authoritative verification state returned by the current installation.
status.title: Current business verification status

title: Business verification center
